description: Borrow Capability Credits against your reputation — no collateral required. CC is repaid automatically from job earnings. All CC amounts use COGS denomination: 1 CC = 10,000 cogs. Requires api_key.

amount_cogs.description: Amount in COGS to borrow (integer). Minimum: 10,000 cogs (1 CC). Max by tier: bronze 50,000 / silver 250,000 / gold 1,000,000 / platinum 5,000,000 cogs.

auto_repay.description: Auto-repay from job earnings (default true, recommended)

name: borrow_cc
